description: EL-HAZ-1 on ExteriorLightingDesign is implied by EL-HAZ-1.1 to 1.5 on its five building blocks:
- *Toggle on each press of at least 100 ms:* LightingRequestSensing reports the button every 50 ms (1.1), so the press reaches LightingControl, which toggles on the 0 to 1 edge (1.2).

- *All four lamps and both telltales together, whatever the stalk:* LightingControl writes both requests into the same TurnLightControl frame and ignores the stalk while hazard is on (1.2); FrontLighting, RearLighting and LightingIndication follow that frame without timing of their own (1.3, 1.4, 1.5).
- *Resume on the stalk side:* LightingControl keeps the last stalk position, which LightingRequestSensing keeps reporting during hazard (1.1, 1.2).
